SELECT t1.Description 
FROM products t1 
JOIN transactions_1k t2 
ON t1.ProductID = t2.ProductID 
JOIN gasstations t3 
ON t2.GasStationID = t3.GasStationID 
WHERE t3.Country = 'Czech Republic'

SELECT p.Description 
FROM transactions_1k t 
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID 
JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID 
WHERE g.Country = 'Czech Republic';

FROM products AS t1 
JOIN transactions_1k AS t2 ON t1.ProductID = t2.ProductID 
JOIN gasstations AS t3 ON t2.GasStationID = t3.GasStationID 
WHERE t3.Country = 'Czech Republic'
